scope: Original sound set for the ebru-ink slot: base / idle / feature themes, ambience, free-spins intro, retrigger, feature outro, total-win fanfare, win tiers 1–4 + max (heads, count-up beds, tier-ups, landings), 6 multiplier/stain callout classes, the comb sweep (pitch contour from the engine row shifts), drop-in, bleed, cluster bloom by colour, stain growth by value, scatter landings and trigger, UI effects, wordless vocal placeholders and an 18-line recorded voice-bank slot. Presentation only; nothing reads or changes a result.
originality: All music and effects are original note data and code synthesis (lib/slot-audio/scores/ebru.ts, sfx/ebru.ts, synth/ebru.ts, synth/anatolian.ts ney/frame drum). No samples, no recordings, no third-party melodies or motifs; no existing game, film or song imitated. Only the generic shape of two traditional usul (Sofyan, Düyek) is used. Instruments are synthesized approximations (kanun-like Karplus-Strong zither, ud-like lute, ney-like flute, glass harmonica, water glasses, kudüm-like drums, frame drum, zil, wordless ah choir, bubbles/water).

environment.machine: cloud container, 4 vCPU shared with other agents (load average 5–8 during these runs, so absolute load times are pessimistic; compare with the Tarhun and Candy Cascade loads measured in the same run)

method: Headless Chromium, production code path: prebuilt render worker bundle (Web Worker pool, 3 workers) for synthesis + OfflineAudioContext reverb + JS mastering; BS.1770 loudness, 4× true peak, loop seam statistic; 16-bit TPDF WAV export. Escalation and runtime chain run through the real bus graph (buildBusGraph) at the default mix.
commands: bash scripts/use-node.sh node ebru-measure.tmp.mjs music|sfx|comb|load|chain|escalation|cascadeload (harness copied into apps/web temporarily, then removed)

combSweep.note: scheduleCombSweep (production code) through the real bus graph at the default mix; contour = combPlan(engine shifts) for 4 (A, p, q) cases.

music.about: G Rast (G A B C D E F#, descending F), 96 BPM, 18-bar seamless loop (45 s). A: the 4-bar "drop and ripple" hook on a kanun-like zither with a water-glass ping on every drop, its answer (acem F down, F# up) over ud low plucks in Sofyan usul · B: A Uşşak — the ud sings with its Bb neighbour, ney an octave up, wordless "ah" choir and glass harmonica, kudüm in Düyek · C: breakdown in the Hüzzam colour over D — ney over glass drones, frame-drum heartbeat, rising bubbles, a kanun run up into the hook.

G Rast, 96 BPM, 8-bar loop (20 s): the hook on a glass harmonica, its answer on a breathy ney, sparse kanun plucks, a G–D drone, "ah" choir at the cadences, a soft frame drum and slow bubbles; no kudüm.

D Rast (D E F# G A B C#, C natural descending), 116 BPM, 16-bar loop (33.1 s). A: the kanun riff (the drop-and-ripple motif a fifth up, twice as busy) over a 16th kanun ostinato, an ud riff and kudüm in a driving Düyek · B: the ney sings the euphoric answer up to F#6 with kanun tremolo an octave below, "ah" choir, glass bells and a low frame drum on every downbeat; driving bass, bubbles, a kudüm roll back into A.
Ambience, 24 s seamless loop: still size water in the marbling trough — slow lapping, a faint surface hiss, small bubbles and an occasional drip, with a quiet room tone; no tempo-bound material.

Free-spins intro, D Rast, 116 BPM: the golden chime cascade — a 32nd-note kanun glissando up the D pentatonic to A6 while water glasses fall back down, an "ah" choir swell, a frame-drum roll and rising bubbles, then a D major strum with glass bells, zil and a low ud D on beat 4; the feature theme enters at beat 6 (3.10 s).

Retrigger (+4), D Rast, 116 BPM, 1 bar: a 32nd-note kanun flourish A–B–D–E–F#–A up to a held D6 with its tremolo, water-glass pings D6/A6, zil and a kudüm hit, a puff of bubbles; ends at beat 3 (1.55 s) and rings over the feature theme.

Feature outro ("the garden settles"), G Rast, 96 BPM: C – D | G with a ney phrase D–E–D–B–A–B–D falling to G, kanun strums, glass harmonica and "ah" choir, a last water-glass drop and slow bubbles; the base theme may return at beat 6 (3.75 s).

Total-win fanfare, G Rast-major, 120 BPM, 4 s: G – Em – C | D – G. A festive kanun flourish with ney doubling, kanun strums, glass harmonica, "ah" choir on the final G with water-glass bells, kudüm and frame drum, zil and a bloom of bubbles.

Big win tier 1 (Büyük), G Rast-major, 120 BPM, 2 bars (4 s): a kanun ripple climbing over a 16th kanun ostinato, glass harmonica chords, ney on the long notes, kudüm and frame drum; it lands on a held tonic with an ud strum, a water-glass bell, zil and a burst of bubbles.

Big win tier 2 (Mega), A Rast-major, 120 BPM, 2 bars (4 s): a kanun ripple climbing over a 16th kanun ostinato, glass harmonica chords, ney on the long notes, "ah" choir, kudüm and frame drum; it lands on a held tonic with an ud strum, a water-glass bell, zil and a burst of bubbles.

Big win tier 3 (Süper), B Rast-major, 120 BPM, 3 bars (6 s): a kanun ripple climbing over a 16th kanun ostinato, glass harmonica chords, ney on the long notes, "ah" choir, kudüm and frame drum, a riser and double-time kudüm; it lands on a held tonic with an ud strum, a water-glass bell, zil and a burst of bubbles.

Big win tier 4 (Efsane), D Rast-major, 120 BPM, 3 bars (6 s): I – IV | ii – V | I. Kanun lead with ney doubling and kanun tremolo an octave below, full "ah" choir, glass harmonica, water-glass bells on every downbeat, kudüm roll into the last bar, zil and two bubble bursts.

Max win, E (top of the key ladder), 120 BPM, 3 bars (6 s): IV – V – bVII – I (A – B – D – E) with kanun and ney in octaves, kanun tremolo, full "ah" choir, glass harmonica, water-glass bells climbing, a 16th kanun ostinato, an ud strum, double-time kudüm with a roll, zil and the biggest bubble bloom.
Count-up bed tier 1: I – IV – vi – IV/V in G Rast-major at 120 BPM, 4-bar seamless loop (8 s); kanun 16ths, drone, bass, frame drum and kudüm tek.
Count-up bed tier 2: I – IV – vi – IV/V in A Rast-major at 120 BPM, 4-bar seamless loop (8 s); kanun 16ths, drone, bass, frame drum and kudüm tek + kudüm groove, glass harmonica, zil.

Count-up bed tier 3: I – IV – vi – IV/V in B Rast-major at 120 BPM, 4-bar seamless loop (8 s); kanun 16ths, drone, bass, frame drum and kudüm tek + kudüm groove, glass harmonica, zil + kanun lead and tek 8ths.

Count-up bed tier 4: I – IV – vi – IV/V in D Rast-major at 120 BPM, 4-bar seamless loop (8 s); kanun 16ths, drone, bass, frame drum and kudüm tek + kudüm groove, glass harmonica, zil + kanun lead and tek 8ths + "ah" choir, water-glass bells, low frame drum.

Count-up bed max win: I – IV – vi – IV/V in E Rast-major at 120 BPM, 4-bar seamless loop (8 s); kanun 16ths, drone, bass, frame drum and kudüm tek + kudüm groove, glass harmonica, zil + kanun lead and tek 8ths + "ah" choir, water-glass bells, low frame drum + ney an octave up, an ud riff and bubbles.

escalation.note: Büyük → Mega → Süper → Efsane → max with count-up ticks; tier-up hits on the 120 BPM grid (planTierUp), landing at 22.3 s.

loadTiming.note: Core = base theme + base-game effects incl. the four comb layers (rendered in parallel). Feature theme, stingers and the celebration group follow lazily in the background. Until a lazy asset lands, the event falls back (callout → total-mult hit, landing → ding, others → live fallback voice).

limitations: Nobody has listened to this set: the author cannot hear. Owner listening acceptance is required (WAV per asset; ebru-comb-sweeps.wav is the signature sound, ebru-escalation-max.wav the full climb).
Instruments are synthesized approximations, not recordings; kanun, ud and ney colour may read as "synth" on good speakers. Makam colours are 12-TET approximations (no quarter tones).
Vocal callouts are wordless synthetic placeholders; recorded lines plug into setVoiceBank("/audio/voice/ebru") and were tested with fakes only.
The live master limiter is a DynamicsCompressor, not a true-peak limiter: see runtimeChain for the stacked-effects worst case. Every rendered asset is below −1 dBTP.
Very short UI effects (click, tick, coin) read under their momentary class target because they are shorter than the 400 ms window (same as the other sets).
Not verified: GitHub CI, a production (next build / Cloudflare) runtime, Safari/Firefox, mobile devices, and the game screen wiring (components/ebru/** is another agent's).
